owner_approval: 2026-10-14, in chat: approved, long-only, run A19 on a new branch
why_this_exists: A18 (theme diffusion) rests on one mechanism: news reaches the obvious firms first and their less obvious, economically linked peers later. Theme-level timing cannot be tested on history (10-30 correlated themes, winners known). The firm-level form can: does the recent return of a firm's product-market peers, as measured from 10-K text, predict its own next return once its own momentum and its industry's return are removed? Hoberg & Phillips (JFQA 2018) report this; OSAP on disk shows every related linked-firm spillover it carries below t 1.5 since 2013. Step 353 put the prior at roughly one in ten. This is the cheapest test that can kill the idea.
the_order_of_work_is_fixed_by_CLAUDE_md_: Skill screen first. A book is built ONLY if the screen passes every criterion below. If no trial passes, no book is built, A19 closes, and A18's diffusion arm closes with it.

data.network: Hoberg-Phillips Data Library TNIC-3 (tnic3_data.zip), columns year, gvkey1, gvkey2, score; year = first four digits of the fiscal-year datadate; the file is NOT lagged (its readme).
data.link_table: farr R package (Ian Gow, MIT), dataset gvkey_ciks: gvkey, iid, cik, first_date, last_date. A gvkey maps to the CIK whose link interval contains the date the TNIC year becomes usable; if none contains it, the CIK with the nearest interval; ties and gvkeys mapping to several CIKs at once are dropped.
data.prices: data/broad_full_history_price_vintages/20261010T135148Z-broad-full-history-v1, Yahoo daily adjusted closes, one series per CIK (longest history), 2011-01-03 to 2026-10-09
data.liquidity: data/us_daily_volume_v1: 63-day rolling median of close x volume
data.industry: as-filed SIC from SEC FSDS sub.txt 2012Q1-2022Q4, latest filing accepted before the decision, carried forward after 2022Q4 (as Step 343). Before the first FSDS filing a firm has no SIC and is excluded.

point_in_time_rule: TNIC year Y is used ONLY for decisions from July 1 of Y+1 to June 30 of Y+2 (the Fama-French / Cohen-Frazzini six-month convention). A fiscal year ending as late as December 31 of Y has its 10-K filed by the end of March Y+1 for all but delinquent filers, so July Y+1 is conservative. No filing-date data is needed and none is used.

decisions_and_windows.cadence: last trading day of each month
decisions_and_windows.holdout_window: 2019-01 to 2025-06. Extended from the design doc's '2019-2023' before any data was seen: with the six-month lag, TNIC year 2023 is usable through June 2025, and no decision after that is scored.
decisions_and_windows.regimes_reported: 2012-2019, 2020, 2021-2022, 2023-2025H1. 2008-2009 is not testable: the daily panel starts in 2011.
decisions_and_windows.skip_one_day: signals use closes up to t; the forward window starts at close t+1 (Step 250's bid-ask bounce excluded)

universe_rule_per_decision: CIK has a close >= $5 on the decision day, 63-day median dollar volume >= $5M (Step 347's rule), 253 days of price history ending on the decision, a known as-of SIC, and at least one TNIC peer that is itself in the price panel with a complete 1-month return. Peers are NOT required to pass the price or liquidity filters: a peer's return is information whatever its size.

signals.peer_return_definition: similarity-weighted mean of peers' returns, weights = TNIC score, over peers with a complete return over the window
signals.T1_all_peers_1m: all TNIC-3 peers, peer return over the 21 trading days ending at t; horizon 1 month (21 trading days)
signals.T2_non_sic3_peers_1m: only peers whose as-of SIC3 differs from the focal firm's (Hoberg & Phillips' 'less visible' peers); 21-day peer return; horizon 1 month. Firms with no non-SIC3 peer are excluded from T2.
signals.T3_gap_6m: all-peer return over the 126 trading days ending at t MINUS the firm's own return over the same 126 days; horizon 1 month
signals.T4_non_sic3_peers_3m: T2's signal, horizon 3 months (63 trading days)
signals.residualisation_declared: each decision, the raw signal is replaced by the residual of a cross-sectional OLS of the signal on (own 21-day return, own 12-1 momentum = return from t-252 to t-21, leave-self-out equal-weight SIC2 21-day return). Only the residual is ranked. The raw signal is reported as a diagnostic, never as the verdict.
signals.declared_sign: POSITIVE for all four. A negative result is a refutation and is never inverted.

target: raw forward return from close t+1 over the horizon; ranks are cross-sectional so the market is removed. SIC2-relative forward return reported as a diagnostic only.

measurement.per_decision: Spearman rank IC; decile mean forward returns (ten deciles on the residual score)
measurement.ladder: the decision-average decile ladder, read with scripts/decile_shape.py: shape(), clears() on the full ladder AND the middle eight, and placebo_test() (Step 339 sign-flip null)
measurement.density_guard: the residual score is continuous; report the share of exact-zero raw signals and stop as unreadable if above 50%
measurement.significance: block bootstrap on the IC series, 4000 draws, block 6 decisions for 1-month horizons and 9 for the 3-month horizon (overlap)
measurement.cumulative_search_note: These four sit on top of 352 steps of search on the same price panel, including Step 320's BRAIN product-overlap spillover. Any pass is the survivor of a far larger search and will be described that way.
measurement.placebo_network: 200 draws. Each draw keeps every firm's peer count and weights and replaces peer identities by a random permutation of the price-panel issuers (graph structure kept, who-is-linked-to-whom destroyed); the placebo signal is residualised identically. The real design-window mean IC must exceed the placebo 95th percentile.
measurement.comparator_not_a_trial: equal-weight leave-self-out SIC3 peer 21-day return, residualised the same way, horizon 1 month: shows whether text peers add anything over industry codes. Reported, never used for the verdict.
measurement.leave_out: design-window mean IC excluding each SIC2 group in turn (minimum reported) and excluding the 10 names contributing most to IC

screen_pass_requires_all_for_one_trial: design window 2012-2018: mean IC > 0 with bootstrap p < 0.0125
design window: decile_shape.clears(full, middle_8) at bar 0.5, positive direction
design window: real mean IC above the shuffled-network placebo 95th percentile
design window: minimum leave-one-SIC2-out IC > 0 and IC without top-10 names > 0
holdout 2019-2025H1: mean IC > 0 AND decile_shape.clears(full, middle_8) positive
declared_fail_shapes: Step 320's pv13 pattern -- strong extremes, flat or negative middle eight -- is a FAIL, declared before any data was seen. So is a design-window pass that does not repeat in the holdout.

book_only_if_screen_passes.direction: long-only (owner, 2026-10-14). No short leg, no borrowed cash.
book_only_if_screen_passes.rule: top 10% of the liquid universe by the passing trial's residual score; enter in the top 10%, exit below the top 30%; inverse 63-day volatility weights capped at 2% per name; 20% cap per SIC2; monthly
book_only_if_screen_passes.costs: 0, 10, 50, 100 bps per side on traded notional
book_only_if_screen_passes.compare_against: SPY; beta-matched SPY/T-bill blend; equal-weight liquid universe; Step 347 steady-riser book (correlation); FF5+momentum alpha with Newey-West t
book_only_if_screen_passes.report: CAGR, Sharpe, volatility, max drawdown, beta, turnover, per regime, leave-top-5-names-out

known_weaknesses_declared_up_front: Survivorship: 460 of 3,235 requested symbols returned nothing from Yahoo, mostly delisted issuers (Step 343). Missing focal firms bias the cross-section; missing peers thin the peer average.

The Hoberg-Phillips library is re-released periodically; historical years may have been recomputed with later methods. This cannot be verified from outside and is a possible mild look-ahead in the network itself.

farr's gvkey_ciks provenance is not documented on its page; link coverage is measured and reported, and the run stops as inconclusive if under 70% of universe issuers receive a peer set in any design-window year.
SIC carried forward after 2022Q4; firms that began filing after 2022Q4 have no SIC and are excluded.

Monthly cadence gives ~84 design and ~78 holdout decisions; Step 300 showed ~38 decisions suffice to detect IC 0.03 at t=3 on a wide universe, so this is powered for an IC of that size, not for smaller.
